title: Ownership swaps and paired-item mentions
summary: This topic is loosely connected by mentions of owning or swapping multiple vehicles and by references to paired items, with only a few clear complaints in the sample.

negative.summary: Negative comments mention dissatisfaction leading to a vehicle swap and a driver-assistance warning that sometimes misses lane splits.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mostly mention owning or swapping multiple cars, paired accessories or controls, and time-limited credits without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects linked mainly by words such as 'two' and 'swapped' rather than one coherent product issue.
